# TopWebTool — Public Index (llms.txt)

## Site Overview

TopWebTool is a 100% client-side web utility directory offering 84 free online tools across Finance, Marketing, AI, and Developer categories. All tools run entirely in the browser with no server-side processing.

## Public Assets

- [Homepage](/index.html) — Main tool directory with search and category grid
- [Global Script](/global.js) — Shared JS for themes, header, footer, sidebar, and ad placements
- [Stylesheet](/styles.css) — Global CSS with dark/light mode support

## WebMCP Support

All client-side tools on TopWebTool support native browser invocation via WebMCP. AI browsing agents can interact with any tool by registering the tool's form inputs and triggering the existing button click handlers programmatically.
